title: Thimsy ES-DE/nano/systems.linux.json
description: Linux's own emulator choices: per system, and per game (proposed). Written only by Linux; Android ignores it and never deletes it (interop Q4; LIBRARY-FORMAT.md 4.9). A choice is a portable emulator key, never a path or a command. Thimsy-new file: this schema is what a writer of contract major 1 emits; readers keep unknown fields. Only the draft-07 keywords devicejson.py validates are used.

systems.description: Keyed by the system's id in nano/systems.json (nes, psx, n64).

games.description: Proposed (W7-INTEROP): Linux's per-game choices, keyed exactly as nano/emulators.json keys a game: the ES-DE folder, '/', the path relative to it, case kept, no './'.

emu_key.description: core:<libretro name without suffix>, emu:<standalone id>, or family:<save-compatible family>.

set.description: When the user chose it; informational.
